name: roster-semicolon-delimited-french-excel.csv
tests: `;` separator — the default of Excel on a French/European locale
expect: REFUSED: no email column (DictReader assumes comma)

name: roster-tab-delimited-export.csv
tests: Tab separator, common from database exports
expect: REFUSED: no email column

name: roster-european-decimal-comma-salary.csv
tests: Salary written 85000,50 — decimal comma, French/German convention
expect: SILENT CORRUPTION: comma stripped -> 8500050

name: roster-german-thousands-dot-decimal-comma.csv
tests: Salary written 85.000,50 — dot thousands + comma decimal
expect: SILENT CORRUPTION: -> 85.0005

name: roster-space-thousands-separator.csv
tests: Salary written '85 000' — the official French thousands separator
expect: REFUSED or row skipped: float() rejects the space

name: roster-salary-with-currency-suffix-eur.csv
tests: Salary written '85000 EUR' rather than a bare number
expect: REJECTED: only '$' is stripped

name: roster-salary-in-tunisian-dinar.csv
tests: Non-USD currency with a three-decimal minor unit (TND)
expect: Parsed as a plain number; currency is silently lost

name: roster-utf8-bom-excel-export.csv
tests: UTF-8 byte-order mark before the header, as Excel writes it
expect: OK: utf-8-sig decode strips the BOM

name: roster-latin1-encoded-accented-names.csv
tests: Latin-1 encoding with accented French names
expect: OK: falls back to latin-1 after UTF-8 fails

name: roster-title-rows-above-header.csv
tests: Two report/title lines before the real header, as Excel exports do
expect: REFUSED: line 1 is read as the header

name: roster-trailing-total-and-blank-rows.csv
tests: A TOTAL row and blank padding after the data, as spreadsheets add
expect: Data rows OK; the TOTAL row should be skipped (no email)

name: roster-quoted-fields-containing-commas.csv
tests: Quoted values containing commas (job title with a comma)
expect: OK: csv module handles quoting

name: roster-same-employee-listed-twice-conflicting.csv
tests: One employee on two rows with different salaries
expect: OPEN DEFECT: last row silently wins, no conflict raised

name: roster-single-data-row-minimal-columns.csv
tests: Smallest valid roster: email column only
expect: OK: one row, nothing to propose

name: performance-review-markdown-with-rating-table.md
tests: Markdown with the rating inside a pipe table
expect: Should extract 4.0 from the table

name: resignation-letter-markdown-formatted.md
tests: Markdown resignation with headings and a bullet list
expect: Should extract normally; markup must not leak into note_text

name: performance-review-single-page-formal.pdf
tests: Straightforward one-page PDF
expect: Should extract 4.5

name: resignation-letter-two-page-pdf.pdf
tests: Content split across two PDF pages
expect: Both pages must be concatenated before extraction

name: cv-two-column-layout-interleaves-on-extract.pdf
tests: Two visual columns — PDF text order follows the content stream, not the eye
expect: Text likely interleaves; extraction may still recover email + name

name: offer-letter-pdf-with-letterhead-and-footer.pdf
tests: Letterhead and footer noise around the substantive terms
expect: Should extract department + base salary, ignoring footer

name: resignation-letter-written-in-french.txt
tests: Entirely French prose — the working language of many Sopra HR clients
expect: Should extract; note_text will be French

name: performance-review-written-in-french.txt
tests: French review with the rating expressed as 'Note globale : 4/5'
expect: Should extract 4.0

name: resignation-letter-mixed-french-and-english.txt
tests: Code-switching between French and English mid-document
expect: Should still extract email + date

name: performance-review-letter-grade-scale-a-to-f.txt
tests: Rating given as a letter grade with no numeric scale stated
expect: Ambiguous: A on an A-F scale should map to 5.0

name: performance-review-percentage-score-82.txt
tests: Score as a percentage rather than a scale point
expect: 82% should map to roughly 4.1 on 1-5

name: performance-review-star-rating-four-of-five.txt
tests: Rating drawn as star glyphs
expect: Should read 4.0 from the glyphs

name: performance-review-inverted-scale-1-is-best.txt
tests: German-style scale where 1 is BEST and 5 is worst
expect: TRAP: naive reading gives 1.0 when the true 1-5-higher-better value is 5.0

name: resignation-letter-ambiguous-date-03-04-2026.txt
tests: Date written 03/04/2026 with no locale cue
expect: AMBIGUOUS: 3 April (EU) or 4 March (US) — no way to disambiguate

name: performance-review-fiscal-year-ends-in-june.txt
tests: Review period is a fiscal year (Jul-Jun), not a calendar year
expect: review_period_end must be 2025-06-30, not 2025-12-31

name: performance-review-two-employees-in-one-file.txt
tests: Two complete reviews concatenated into one upload
expect: Schema holds one employee — the second must not be silently dropped

name: resignation-letter-empty-file.txt
tests: Zero-byte upload
expect: Must refuse cleanly, not crash

name: resignation-letter-whitespace-only.txt
tests: Whitespace only — looks non-empty by size
expect: Must refuse cleanly

name: resignation-letter-email-thread-with-quoted-replies.txt
tests: Forwarded thread where the resignation is buried under quoted replies
expect: Must attribute to the resigning employee, not the last sender

name: performance-review-very-long-15kb-buried-rating.txt
tests: ~15 KB of filler with the rating in the final paragraph
expect: Tests context handling — rating must survive the length

name: performance-review-ocr-garbled-characters.txt
tests: Simulated OCR damage: rn->m, l->1, O->0 confusions
expect: Should still recover email and rating, or refuse honestly

name: offer-letter-salary-in-tunisian-dinar.txt
tests: Compensation in TND with a local formatting convention
expect: base_salary should be the number; currency is not modelled

name: roster-excel-workbook-unsupported-type.xlsx
tests: A real .xlsx binary signature — an unsupported file type
expect: Must refuse with the supported-types message, not crash
